disjoint_arm.membership: FIXED - all 214 train-only segments from all 14 train-only parents; the pool is exhausted, so no alternative membership exists

arm_construction.exact_window_matching_note: every RoboticArm training segment contains exactly 74 windows, so matching segment counts matches window counts exactly with no approximation

overlap_arm.rule: draw 14 crossing parents uniformly without replacement under numpy default_rng(20260908); reject the draw unless those parents can supply the disjoint arm's exact per-stratum segment counts; then draw the required number of segments per stratum from the candidates sorted by (parent, segment_id)

forbidden: the published AUC is inflated by exactly X
X is the general real-world leakage penalty
X applies to other model families
this is causal proof of leakage inflation
claim_boundary.mandatory_qualifier: both arms train on 11.6 percent of the official training volume and on a source-domain-only, 12-stratum restricted subset, so delta describes this restricted regime and not the official baseline's training conditions
permitted: Under the frozen official-baseline model and preprocessing and the matched training design, parent-overlap presence was associated with a delta X difference in measured RoboticArm AUROC.
Removing same-parent training siblings changed measured performance by delta X under this controlled sensitivity design.

classification_note: This design was created after Phase-3.3 Protocol-A performance was observed. The overlap risk was known earlier, but the design is post-test. It is not untouched confirmatory evidence, not preregistered-before-all-results evidence, not independent validation, and not causal proof of leakage inflation.

device_policy.note: each arm trains on 15836 windows, 11.6 percent of the official 136086, so a run costs roughly 11.6 percent of the 3 h 44 m official RoboticArm training
device_policy.prohibition: a CPU arm must never be compared against a CUDA arm
device_policy.requirement: one environment frozen before execution and identical across every arm

experimental_units.segment: released segment (exactly 74 windows for RoboticArm training)

frozen_components.dataset: IMAD-DS Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.12665499, same release as Phase 3.3
frozen_components.model: official fully connected autoencoder [2048,2048,2048,16] with BatchNorm1d in every hidden block, mirrored decoder, 40,789,724 parameters, upstream best-checkpoint aliasing reproduced
frozen_components.preprocessing: exact Protocol-A implementation: 16000/7063/7063 Hz, 100 ms windows, right-inclusive slicing, zero pad/truncate, 35 ms gyroscope warm-up, upstream std_window normalisation
frozen_components.prohibited: no Protocol-B model, feature, split or threshold may enter this experiment
frozen_components.representation: raw standardised multi-sensor windows, 5836-dimensional flattened input
frozen_components.scoring: reconstruction error, same sensor combination, segment-median aggregation, upstream strict pairwise AUC with exact ties scoring zero
frozen_components.test_cohort: official RoboticArm test cohort, 464 segments, 34336 windows, cohort hash 83cd11956f8ee94907bcf366605259d4986acca8ff69a5bceb3874ee6a7a8efa
frozen_components.training: Adam, lr 1e-4, MSE, batch 1024, num_epochs 1000, patience 3, valid_size 0.1, train loader shuffle True, validation shuffle False

ledger_policy.rule: a ledger entry is appended before each first test look under the new protocol

primary_estimand.definition: delta_AUROC = mean over (replicate, seed) of AUROC_overlap - mean over seed of AUROC_disjoint, on the fixed official 464-segment RoboticArm test cohort, using the upstream strict pairwise AUC with segment-median aggregation
primary_estimand.name: overlap-associated AUC difference under the controlled matched design
primary_estimand.sign_interpretation: a positive delta means the overlap-containing training arm yielded a higher measured AUC under this controlled design

research_question: Under the official RoboticArm preprocessing, architecture, hyperparameters and fixed official test cohort, how much does measured anomaly-discrimination performance change when training examples from the same physical parent recordings as test examples are excluded?
residual_confounds: the disjoint arm has exactly one possible membership because its 14-parent pool is exhausted, so overlap status is confounded with the identity of those particular parents
train-only parents are systematically shorter recordings (median 8.5 segments per parent versus 33.0 for crossing parents), so they may differ in recording character
both arms exclude 13 of the 25 official training strata, including every Normal_Target_Train segment, weights 20/25/30/35 and backgrounds B/E/G
neither arm reproduces the official baseline's training distribution, so the contrast does not estimate the effect on the published result

score_persistence_requirement.reason: Phase 3.3 could not be independently re-audited because per-segment scores were never written; that must not recur
score_persistence_requirement.timing: written before aggregate metrics are finalised, atomically with the evaluation output

secondary_estimands: difference in the normal-test segment score distribution
difference in the anomaly-test segment score distribution

descriptive only: normal test segments with a training sibling versus without - observational, because parent identity and operating conditions differ; must never be used as the primary causal estimate

seeds.policy: all seeds declared before execution; applied identically to both arms; no seed may be chosen, discarded or reweighted on the basis of any observed performance

stopping_and_failure_policy.if_an_arm_fails_to_train: record the failure, do not substitute a different seed or membership, and report the arm as incomplete
stopping_and_failure_policy.if_results_are_null: a delta near zero is a publishable result and must be reported with the same prominence as a large delta
stopping_and_failure_policy.no_post_hoc_changes: arm memberships, seeds, estimands and the uncertainty procedure are frozen by this config and may not be altered after any score is observed

uncertainty.asymmetry_disclosure: membership variability is estimable for the overlap arm only. The disjoint arm has exactly one possible membership, so its spread reflects seed variation alone.
uncertainty.procedure: class-stratified parent-cluster bootstrap over the fixed official test cohort
rules: identical parent bootstrap draws applied across all arms
paired contrasts computed within each bootstrap draw
all sibling segments of a parent move together
windows are never resampled; the evaluation unit is the segment score and the resampling unit is the parent recording
training-set and seed variation reported separately from test-cohort resampling variation, never pooled into a single interval that implies more independent replication than exists

validation_split_policy.decision: retain the upstream window-level stratified validation split identically in every arm
validation_split_policy.limitation: windows from one parent therefore appear in both training and validation within every arm, so validation loss is optimistic and early stopping is not clean model selection - identically in both arms
validation_split_policy.reason: changing it would alter more than parent train/test overlap and would break comparability with the Phase-3.3 anchor
validation_split_policy.secondary_variant: a parent-disjoint validation variant may be proposed later as a separate sensitivity experiment; it must not be folded into the primary contrast

verdict_reason: A genuinely matched contrast is constructible - 214 segments, 14 parents and 12 strata match exactly across arms - so the comparison is not hopeless. But three residual confounds are structural and cannot be designed away: the disjoint arm has exactly one possible membership, its 14 parents are systematically shorter recordings, and both arms must exclude 13 of 25 strata including every target-domain training segment.
